name: Minami Yuuki
source:
The main character, Yuuki Minami. He skipped grades and is starting in high school. He is small and cute which makes him popular with older women.

While being tossed around by temptations lurking in every corner, he leads a sweet and lewd school life.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180121082105/https://7thdoor.x.fc2.com/HP/7th_index.html]official site[/url]]
